The '''Delmaasi pirates'''<ref name="EGTW" /> originated in<ref name="Planetnamia" /> the [[Delmaas system/Legends|Delmaas system]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Seswenna sector/Legends|Seswenna sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> In [[66 BBY/Legends|66 BBY]], the [[Seswenna Defense Forces]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]] [[Ranulph Tarkin/Legends|Ranulph Tarkin]] led a successful campaign against the [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]].<ref name="EGTW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Delmaasi pirates were introduced in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]].<ref name="EGTW" />
